info.name: Simple Bank API
info.description: Start the backend first (./mvnw spring-boot:run, connected to MongoDB Atlas), then run the whole collection with the Runner, folders in order. 'Happy path' creates, reads and updates users and accounts, moves money (deposit, withdraw, transfer), and pages through lists and history. 'Business rules and errors' checks that every rule returns the right status code. 'Cleanup' empties and deletes everything that was created.

exec: // Unique email each run, so the collection can be run repeatedly
pm.test('At least the 2 new accounts exist', () => pm.expect(page.totalElements).to.be.at.least(2));
pm.test('Shows the updated owner name', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().userName).to.eql('John Smith'));
pm.test('Is not the last page', () => pm.expect(page.last).to.eql(false));
